title: Indicators Cheat Sheet
html:
IndicatorWhat it tells youHow we use it
20-day SMAShort-term trendPrice above = short-term buyers in control
50-day SMAMedium-term trendCommon pullback support in uptrends
200-day SMALong-term trend (Paul Tudor Jones's favorite)Above = bull market for that stock; below = defense
Golden / death cross50-day crossing above / below the 200-dayBig-picture trend change signal
RSI (14)Momentum, 0–100>70 overbought, <30 oversold; divergences warn of turns
ATR (14)Average daily range in $Sizes stops: a stop tighter than 1 ATR gets hit by noise
VolumeConvictionBreakouts on heavy volume are more trustworthy
VIXFear in the S&P 500 options market>20 = nervous market, options cost more
